arcs.title: The Porch Railing Situation
arcs.summary: Day 4: Adam has confirmed Saturday arrival. Steve and the railing observed a mutual silence through Thursday evening. The oak is structurally present. Don's portrait is confident. Christine's ledger is up to date. Day 4 (resolution, filing Saturday): Adam arrives, Steve and Adam conduct the inspection together, the level is consulted, the oak is assessed, the creak is explained — something satisfying, funny, and slightly vindicating for Don. The bracket question is settled, one way or another, in the tradition of all great home construction.

arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
arcs.summary: Day 1: A twelfth duck has appeared on the Jeep wearing a small orange knitted scarf. The deerstalker duck remains in position. No one has touched the new duck. The Duck Bandit's methods are escalating from placement to costuming. Day 2 should develop the mystery — perhaps the scarf matches nothing in the household, or a second accessory appears on a different duck, or someone in the wider wizarding Jeep community reports a similar incident and the Prophet begins to suspect a pattern.
